project.title: Secure Password Management System
project.shortDescription: A secure web dashboard with AES-256 encryption, SHA-256 hashing, and two-factor authentication.
project.description: Built a secure password management system with AES-256 encryption and SHA-256 hashing. Implemented OTP-based two-factor authentication through email verification. Designed a modern dashboard UI using ReactJS and Material UI.
features: End-to-end local encryption of passwords before sync.
Two-factor authentication with automated email verification.
Robust password generator with customizable complexity metrics.
Security audit dashboard showing weak or compromised passwords.
